prompt:
Create a FOUR-STATE MOTION AND LIGHTING DESIGN COMPARISON SHEET of the single miniature toy asset in the provided reference. This is NOT a multi-camera turnaround: ALL FOUR CELLS MUST USE THE EXACT SAME front three-quarter CAMERA, same magnification, same perspective, same position on ground, identical static geometry and materials. Reference is a 4-view identity sheet; take its bottom-right three-quarter angle and repeat that angle in all four cells. Landscape 1536x1024-like 3:2 image, precisely equal 2x2 grid with generous white margins and fine light-gray divider lines at exact center. Top-left is state 1, top-right state 2, bottom-left state 3, bottom-right state 4. White neutral studio background and constant soft neutral studio illumination; lighting changes ONLY from specified miniature practical lights; never change overall exposure or backdrop to fake a state change. Closed full object silhouettes, no cropping. Ivory, mint, peach premium tabletop model craftsmanship. No track, environment, people, extra props, text, numbers, captions, arrows or watermark. No ghosting, no motion blur, no duplicate moving parts inside a cell. Preserve shape topology, counts and colors across all cells. Show different actual joint positions or light colors as specified, freezing time at each state; no deformation of rigid structures. Newly animated areas must stay physically supported. Each panel shows a single complete instance. Asset ID: 08-service-robot.
STATE 1: Neutral relaxed A-pose as reference, cyan oval eyes, soft antenna light.
STATE 2: Raise robot's RIGHT arm in greeting with elbow slightly bent, head yaw 15 degrees toward that hand, bright cyan eyes, warm antenna.
STATE 3: Robot's LEFT arm extends sideways to point with same C-shaped gripper, head yaw minus 25 degrees following arm. Body and feet anchored.
STATE 4: Arms relaxed, head tilted slightly downward, visor eyes become two short dim blue horizontal sleeping slits, antenna off. Feet unchanged.
Mechanism note: 姿势为表演关键帧；模型生成仍使用中性A姿势。不要用不同状态重建多个机器人模型。
layout: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right; same camera
review_note: 概念关键帧；具体角度、灯光强度和关节约束以motion.json为准，图像并非同一3D网格的精确渲染。
